description: This file defines the absl::Span template class for referencing contiguous array data without owning it, along with factory functions MakeSpan() and MakeConstSpan(). It includes constructors, accessors, subspan operations, comparison operators, and hash support, serving as a lightweight array view utility.

classes.name: absl::Span
classes.description: A lightweight, non-owning reference to a contiguous sequence of elements of type T, supporting construction from containers, arrays, pointers, and initializer lists, with various accessors, subspan operations, and comparison operators.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data array.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the size of the span (alias for size()).

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element at index i with bounds check.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses element at index i with bounds check and exception.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns reference to first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns reference to last element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to first element.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns const iterator to first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator past last element.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns const iterator past last element.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to last element.

methods.name: crbegin
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator to last element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator before first element.

methods.name: crend
methods.description: Returns const reverse iterator before first element.

methods.name: remove_prefix
methods.description: Removes first n elements from the span.

methods.name: remove_suffix
methods.description: Removes last n elements from the span.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a subspan starting at position with length.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span of the first n elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span of the last n elements.

methods.name: AbslHashValue
methods.description: Hash function support for Span.
